edges.reason: update() is gated by checkEpoch, which derives its allow condition from block.timestamp (now >= nextEpochPoint()), making execution time-dependent.
The checkEpoch modifier controls whether update() body executes and increments the epoch afterwards.
blockTimestampLast is the subtrahend in the wrapping uint32 subtraction producing timeElapsed.
The uint32 subtraction result is assigned to the timeElapsed local variable.
timeElapsed is used as the divisor of the cumulative price delta in update(), a division-by-zero risk mitigated only by an early return.
Observed cumulatives feed the subtraction inside the division expression.
price0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the observed cumulative before division.
update() reads the stored cumulative price of token0.
update() reads the stored cumulative price of token1.
The external library call returns price0Cumulative into a local used by update().
The external library call returns price1Cumulative into a local used by update().
The external library call returns the current blockTimestamp into a local used by update().
The stored pair address is the target of the external calls made to Uniswap.
The division result is truncated to uint224 and stored into price0Average.
update() writes blockTimestampLast at the end of a successful run.
update() overwrites price0CumulativeLast with the observed cumulative.
update() overwrites price1CumulativeLast with the observed cumulative.
update() stores the newly computed average into price1Average.
The observed token1 cumulative local is consumed by the update() computation.
currentCumulativePrices is called by update() and its three return values drive the whole computation.
checkEpoch on update() reads and rewrites the epoch counter via getCurrentEpoch helpers.
nextEpochPoint() multiplies the current epoch by the period, so epoch affects the gating timestamp.
period is multiplied by epoch inside nextEpochPoint().
startTime is the additive base of the nextEpochPoint() computation.
setPeriod() is guarded by onlyOperator, which compares msg.sender against the stored operator.
The onlyOperator modifier validates msg.sender against _operator.
transferOwnership() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
The stored _operator value is the reference used by the onlyOperator check.
The stored _owner value is the reference used by the onlyOwner check.
The new operator argument is assigned into _operator by _transferOperator.
The new owner argument is validated and written into _owner.
The token argument selects which stored average price is consulted.
The amountIn argument is the multiplicand in the consult() quote.
consult() reads price0Average when the token equals token0.
consult() reads price1Average when the token equals token1.
amountIn is multiplied inside FixedPoint.mul, which relies on an overflow require to stay safe.
The FixedPoint.mul result is decoded and returned by consult().
SafeMath division semantics guard the arithmetic used by the price libraries invoked from consult().
The factory parameter is forwarded to UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
tokenA is forwarded to the pair address derivation.
tokenB is forwarded to the pair address derivation.
The _period constructor argument is stored into the Epoch period state variable.
The _startTime constructor argument is stored into the Epoch startTime state variable.
Reserves fetched in the constructor are validated non-zero by the NO_RESERVES require.
The blockTimestampLast returned by getReserves in the constructor is stored as the initial timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: The consult() token parameter is only meaningful as an input selector of the consult function node.
amountIn exists solely to size the quote returned by consult().
The factory parameter is consumed directly by pairFor().
tokenA parameter is consumed directly by pairFor().
tokenB parameter is consumed directly by pairFor().
newOperator_ is only used by the operator access-control transfer path.
newOwner is only used by transferOwnership's ownership update.
timeElapsed is the temporary denominator of the unsafe division operation in update().
price0Cumulative is a transient operand of the division/subtraction inside update().
price1Cumulative is a transient value consumed by update().
blockTimestamp is produced by the external Uniswap call and only feeds update().
The reserve locals only exist for the constructor's reserve sanity require.
_period is a constructor argument immediately bound to Epoch state.
_startTime is a constructor argument immediately bound to Epoch state.
